newsitem.title: CHINA: HUEY TAI INT'L YEAR PROFIT DOWN 18 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUEY TAI INT'L YEAR PROFIT DOWN 18 PCT.

text.p: Exceptional items 39.51 loss vs 39.18 loss (see note)
Company name Huey Tai International Ltd
NOTE - Huey Tai is a property and securities trading group.
The final results of the group for the year ended March 31, 1996 have been reclassified to conform with the current year presentation of Asean Resources Holdings Ltd.
Exceptional gain for the year ended March 31, 1996 of approximately HK$117.07 million has been reclassified as non-exceptional operating profit.
The weighted average number of shares in issue of 1996, which was used for the calculation of the basic earnings per share, was after adjustment for a one-for-one bonus issue during the year.

Net is after an exceptional loss of HK$22.92 million on deemed disposal of the group's interest to Asean Resources Holdings Ltd (ARHL) and loss of HK$16.59 million exprenses incurred in connections with the terminated privatisation of (ARHL).
Total dividend for year is 2.25 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of one cent) vs four cents.
